import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "src"))
from do_again.browser.runtime import browser_self_test, browser_status
result = browser_self_test()
report = {"passed": result.get("response", "").strip() == "DO_AGAIN_BROWSER_OK", "response": result.get("response"), "mode": browser_status().get("mode"), "chat_url": result.get("chat_url"), "repo_head": subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()}
print("DO_AGAIN_FINAL_ROUND_TRIP=" + json.dumps(report),flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report["passed"] else 1)
